trait.name: Voice in the Crowd
entries: The agitator has advantage on Charisma checks made to sway a crowd of five or more creatures.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Work the Crowd
entries: The agitator calls out to bystanders within 60 feet. Each creature of the agitator's choice in that area that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or move up to its speed toward a place, person, or door the agitator names.

bonus.name: Slip the Line
entries: The agitator takes the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action.
Carries the message into rooms and markets. Never armed with anything that would be hard to explain.

trait.name: Cell Discipline
entries: The organizer knows only what it needs to. It has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to conceal the structure or membership of its cell, and magic that would compel it to name a superior reveals only a cover identity.

trait.name: Sapper's Eye
entries: The organizer has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks to find the weak point of a structure, and it deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The organizer makes two attacks.

action.name: Short Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Alchemical Charge (2/Day)
entries: The organizer sets or throws a charge at a point within 30 feet. It detonates immediately, or at the start of a later round the organizer chooses. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. An unattended object or structure in the area takes double damage.
Builds the cell, keeps the lists in its head, and brings down what needs bringing down without a crowd watching.

trait.name: Cell Discipline
entries: The supervisor has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to conceal the structure or membership of its cell, and magic that would compel it to name a superior reveals only a cover identity.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the supervisor is subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity save for half damage, it instead takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

trait.name: Contingency Planned
entries: The supervisor has advantage on Initiative rolls, and it cannot be surprised while conscious in a location it chose.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The supervisor makes two attacks.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage if the supervisor has advantage on the attack roll or an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Give the Word
entries: Up to three allies within 60 feet that can see or hear the supervisor each use their reaction to move up to their speed, make one weapon attack, or take the {@action Hide} action.

bonus.name: Vanish
entries: The supervisor takes the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action. It can {@action Hide} even when only lightly obscured by a crowd.

reaction.name: Not Tonight
entries: When the supervisor is hit by an attack it can see, it halves the damage and moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Runs a city cell and answers to one person nobody in the cell has met. Fights only long enough to leave with the cell intact.

trait.name: Two Registers
entries: Ilna can switch between her stage manner and her working manner as a free action. While in her stage manner she has advantage on Charisma checks made in front of an audience. While in her working manner she has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and on checks made to pass unnoticed.

trait.name: Discipline over Mob
entries: Allies within 30 feet that can hear Ilna have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Nothing Written Down
entries: Ilna keeps no records. Divination and mind-reading magic used against her reveals only what she has rehearsed, unless the caster succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma check contested by her {@skill Deception}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ilna is a 7th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ilna makes two attacks with her dagger, or casts a cantrip and makes one attack.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Captivating Performance (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ilna sings, and every creature of her choice within 60 feet that can hear her must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for 1 minute. A charmed creature is {@condition incapacitated} and has a speed of 0 while it listens. The effect ends for a creature if it takes damage or if someone else uses an action to shake it free.

bonus.name: Misdirect
entries: Ilna takes the {@action Hide} action, or causes one creature she can see within 30 feet to look somewhere she chooses.

reaction.name: Cutting Word
entries: When a creature Ilna can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, Ilna subtracts 6 ({@dice 1d10 + 1}) from the roll.
A performer who runs a city cell out of the room she is performing in. Onstage she is warm, loud, and impossible to look away from. Off it she is quiet and wastes nothing.
She fights to leave, not to win, and she will spend a subordinate's life to do it without changing expression.
